coordinate_calibration.provenance: CARBON-3D-R3: Abaqus SP13_mesh_local_v1_modal is in mm (face plates 510 x 520 mm; t/mm^3 and MPa). Experimental source is the accepted SP-13 REAL-1 lineage frozen in analysis/sp13_real_baseline/SOURCE_FREEZE.json: SP13_a_polymax.unv (Simcenter PolyMAX set Best, child of the Polytec parent SP13_a_500by500_Glue420_Auxetic_newSP01_260910_polytec.unv, METRIC_ABS_(SI)), so coordinates are in metres. Accepted fixed Polytec frame and specimen mounting convention: measured TOP exterior face, no X/Y swap, same-sign identity (experimental +x = FE +X, +y = FE +Y). The centre-to-centre placement is the accepted centred approximation (USER_CONFIRMED_CENTERED_APPROXIMATION / CENTERED_APPROXIMATION), not a measured edge registration. The production nearest-node exterior-surface mapping stored here was validated against the accepted REAL-1 bilinear interpolation in CARBON-3D-R2; the bilinear weights are not stored in this registration.
